sample_unit: head and neck cancer cases (planning CT)

links.outcome: Agreement of AI auto-contours with expert contours on local historical clinical cases (DSC, mean distance)
links.effect: Local validation on 40 cases: mandible DSC 0.90 and 0.91; chiasm DSC 0.28 and 0.30; manual editing likely needed before treatment planning use.
links.quote: EC and AC agreement was highest for the mandible (DSC 0.90 ± 0.16) and (DSC 0.91 ± 0.03), and lowest for the chiasm (DSC 0.28 ± 0.14) and (DSC 0.30 ± 0.14) for AccuContour and ProtégéAI respectively.

screen.reason: Evaluates the geometric accuracy and contouring speed of two commercial deep-learning auto-segmentation tools on retrospective clinical CT scans, without testing an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
